**Core Graphics – Apple Developer Documentation (PDF)** *(All three sources are excerpts from the same Core Graphics developer guide.)* | Section | Key Points | Source | |---------|------------|--------| | **Framework Overview** | • Core Graphics is built on the Quartz 2‑D drawing engine.
• Provides lightweight, low‑level 2‑D rendering with high‑fidelity output.
• Handles path‑based drawing, transformations, color management, off‑screen rendering, patterns, gradients, shadings, image data, image creation, image masking, and PDF document creation, display, and parsing.
• On macOS it also includes services for display‑hardware control, low‑level user‑input events, and the windowing system. | [Source 1] | | **Basic Data Types** | • `CGFloat` – basic floating‑point scalar type.
• `CGPoint` – point in 2‑D space.
• `CGSize` – width & height.
• `CGRect` – rectangle defined by a point and a size. | [Source 1] | | **Core Structures & Enumerations** | • `CGVector`, `CGAffineTransform`, `CGColorSpace`, `CGColor`, `CGPattern`, `CGShading`, `CGGradient`, `CGFunction`, `CGPath`, `CGMutablePath`, `CGLayer`, `CGContext`, `CGImage`, `CGDataProvider`, `CGDataConsumer`, `CGPDFDocument`, `CGPDFMarkedContentItem`, `CGPDFStructureElement`, `CGRenderingBufferProvider`, `CGBitmapParameters`, `CGColorModel`, `CGComponent`, `CGContentInfo`, `CGContentToneMappingInfo`, `CGImageComponentInfo`.
• Enumerations for bitmap layout, component types, etc. | [Source 1] | | **Classes & Their Roles** | • **`CGContext`** – the drawing environment.
• **`CGPath` / `CGMutablePath`** – immutable/ mutable paths for shapes and lines.
• **`CGImage`** – bitmap image or image mask.
• **`CGLayer`** – off‑screen context for reusable content.
• **`CGColor` / `CGColorSpace`** – color components & spaces.
• **`CGFont`** – glyphs & layout for text.
• **`CGPDFDocument`** – PDF file representation.
• **`CGDataProvider` / `CGDataConsumer`** – abstract data I/O. | [Source 1] | | **Services (macOS‑specific)** | • **Quartz Display Services** – direct access to macOS window server for display‑hardware configuration.
• **Quartz Event Services** – manage event taps (filters) for observing/altering low‑level user‑input streams.
• **Quartz Window Services** – information about windows managed by the macOS window server. | [Source 1] | | **Platform & Language Support** | • Available on iOS 2.0+, iPadOS 2.0+, Mac Catalyst 13.1+, macOS 10.8+, tvOS 9.0+, visionOS 1.0+, watchOS 2.0+.
• Primary language: Swift (but also usable from Objective‑C/C). | [Source 1] | | **Documentation Structure** | • The PDF is organized into:
 1. Core Graphics overview & data types.
 2. 2‑D drawing, colors, fonts.
 3. PDF document handling.
 4. Utility & support classes.
 5. Quartz 2‑D programming guide. | [Source 1] | ### Take‑away Summary Core Graphics is the foundational 2‑D rendering engine on Apple platforms, exposing a rich set of low‑level primitives (paths, transforms, colors, gradients, images, PDFs) and a suite of helper classes (`CGContext`, `CGImage`, `CGPath`, etc.). It also bundles macOS‑specific services for display and event handling. The documentation is organized into sections covering data types, drawing APIs, PDF support, utilities, and a programming guide, and is available across all major Apple operating systems with Swift as the primary language.
